# Independent root audit: adaptive critical-cover game and frozen weights


`candidate 507a9e41447b6436`.
This audits finite duality and the stated restricted geometric example;
it does not infer behavior at a bad unrestricted mixed-body minimum.

The equivalence of the all-selection balancing condition and
max_p min_(g in Gamma_p)g(v)>=0 follows from finite strict separation in
each direction. Convexifying menus preserves precisely such strict sign
tests. For fixed base weights, the minima over direction and circuit
choices commute; minimizing a linear form on a norm ball gives minus its
dual norm. Thus V_fixed=-R has no illicit max-min exchange. Compactness
and uniform continuity give attainment. A weighted Minkowski sum of menus
can be the singleton{0} only if every positively weighted menu is itself
a singleton, as subtraction of two choices proves. The diameter lower
bound and its reciprocal-sum constant are correct.

For the interval menus centered at a and -a with radius r, every selection
has opposite signs, the adaptive value is(a-r)|v|, and the frozen radius
is exactly r. No fixed weights can handle even their four endpoints.

The actual family has exact fibers(1+t)K_t and(1-t)K_t, since its two
integer bases are the projection endpoints. The own-fiber depth identity
is valid for every point: an arbitrary own cap can exclude the other
bounded fiber by a finite integer tilt, while any ambient containing cap
has at least the corresponding own-depth mass. Areas are4(1+t)^2 and
4(1-t)^2, so total mass8(1+t^2). Removing at most|t|/2 from the original
square proves D(K_t)>=1/2-|t|/8. Expanding the resulting depth bound gives
exactly |t|(7-2|t|-|t|^2)/[16(1+|t|^2)]>0. The local minimum is explicitly
restricted to this one-parameter family and is above the OC target.

At t=0 the section lengths(2,2,2sqrt(2)) and circuit weights(1,1,sqrt(2))
give equal reciprocal-section probabilities. The own cap derivatives
are(1/2,0,0) for the positive circuit and their negatives for the opposite
circuit. The diagonal's formula2-t^2/[2(1+t)] for t>=0 and2 for t<=0 has
the required common derivative0, with no positive-length supporting-facet
coincidence. Squared scale factors add respectively+4 and-4 to each cap
derivative. Total mass derivative is zero, giving the exact menus
4+[-1/6,1/6] and-4+[-1/6,1/6]. The isolating tilt10 works strictly near0,
and all original caps are truly active at the two square centers. The
frozen radius1/6 and normalized radius1/48 are therefore correct.

The final abstract two-budget model has normalized maximum(1+|x|)/2,
common signed homothety and erosion, and the displayed allocation-specific
positive multipliers summing to2. Varying one allocation while holding
the other fixed disproves a universal fixed multiplier. Its abstract
status and the separate one-sided-cone distinction are both explicit.
No correction is required, and no general OC implication follows.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
